feature: Hand tool: H picks the Hand
summary: As you chose on 2026-10-11, H now picks the Hand, the way it does in Photoshop and in every tool bar your mocks draw, and Highlight moved to U. The release Photonz has no Hand, so H stays Highlight there.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Walk: Scripts/playtest/design-mode-tool-strip-walk.json.

try.do: Open a new window, pick the Design UI tile and press New UI canvas.
Rest the pointer on the hand at the right end of the tool bar: the tip reads Hand H.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Zoom in, press H, and drag the canvas: the view moves.
Press V, then choose Show Everything from the mode menu.
Press U: Highlight lights, and its tip reads Highlight U.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Open Edit > Tools: Highlight shows U and the Hand shows H.

evaluate: Does H for the Hand feel right in a picture window too, not only in Design?
Is U easy enough to find for Highlight, or would you rather it had another letter?
Did anything you used to do with H now surprise you?
rough: People already used to H for Highlight in Next will get the Hand; the tip and Edit > Tools say U straight away (your call on 2026-10-11).
Space still does not borrow the Hand while held, because Space plays and pauses here.
